The *Saṁkiliṭṭhattika* (Patthana 7.5) is a structural section of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final treatise of the canonical Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Like other triad (*tika*) chapters in the collection, it applies the system of conditional relations (*paccaya*) to the triad of corrupt or defiled states (*saṁkiliṭṭha*) set forth in the Abhidhamma matrix (*mātikā*).
